To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The proposed method is able to learn representations of the entities in a text that can be used for relation extraction, and that (ii) the learned representations can be used to identify the relation type between the two entities.

1) The performance of a neural relation extraction system can be improved by using a prototypical representation of the relation classes, 2) the performance can be further improved by using an attention mechanism to select the most important features for the prototypical representations, 3) a neural relation extraction can be improved by training it on a large amount of data from Wikipedia, and 4) a neural relation extractor can outperform state-of-the-art relation extractors on the TACRED dataset.

(1) a prototypical representation learning approach can be successfully applied to the problem of relation extraction and (2) it can be used to learn a model that achieves state-of-the-art results on two benchmark datasets.
